snippet.title: Revelation of Decay - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Revelation of Decay is a multiplayer co-op top-down zombie survival game in pixel art style. Scavenge, craft, recruit NPC followers, and build your base in a crumbling open world. Then take on monstrous bosses in intense, bullet-filled battles. Revelation of Decay will be available on PC in Winter 2025.
